name: Sinon v.1.3.2
body:
### Linux Version is finally available!
### New Mac Legacy version for OS 10.13 and up!

> * **Added** automated release builds with GitHub actions, should be less buggy with quicker turnarounds.
> * **Added** sites to specs, including C-Span, Audioboom.
> * **Updated/Reduced** dependencies. Sinon is lighter, more aerodynamic. Should do fine against cats.
> * **Updated** ffmpeg to the latest version.
> * **Fixed** BBC downloader. iPlayer and Sounds links will now work normally, provided you have get_iplayer installed.
> * **Patched** parsing URLs shared via TikTok or with mobile links
> * **Patched** alert system. Fixed a CSS bug and reduced data input.
> * **Patched** ITV downloader.

name: Sinon v1.3.1
body:
### Post 1.3 patches > * **Added** to Chocolaty. Thank you Nerolynx.
  • Improved Instagram stories parsing, now accepts direct stories URLs.
  • Fixed .m3u8 file downloading.
  • Patched Periscope URL parsing.
  • Patched not spotting Instagram TV links
  • Patched Dark mode switching glitch.
  • Patched ITV and MailOnline database errors.
  • Merged some scripts for ease.

name: Sinon v.1.3
body:
### Overhauled the entire structure of the app. Oh it doesn't look any different? Good. > * **Downloader:** Rewritten. Less errors for main social sites and the improved system should make adding new sites much easier in future.
  • Components: Moved over to a component based UI system, tool swapping should now be more performative and less buggy.
  • Alerts: Should be formatted better and streamlined for some tools.
  • Added keyboard shortcuts for changing tools. Try CTRL/CMD + 1/2/3 to change!
  • Added remuxing to the convertor tool. Much faster for some files.
  • Improved concat effect. It will now join clips that are different resolutions and framerates, you monster.
  • Improved screengrabbing. Now takes frames across the selected clips.
  • Improved version checking. Now finds latest version through API.
  • Tweaked advanced GIF settings.
  • Changed Instagram passwords to not be visable. Duh.
  • Patched not recognising youtu.be short URLs.

name: Sinon v1.2.3
body: ### Really quick patch to just update the youtube-dl backend.

name: Sinon v1.2.2
body:
### Triming and slimming > * **Added** Advanced GIF conversion. Now pick resolution, colour range, fps, compression and crop.
  • Removed jquery! App should be harder, better, faster, stronger
  • Trimmed ffmpeg. App is now 27% smaller.
  • Tweaked most of the javascript. You shouldn't notice much, I'm just writing this to validate myself.
  • Fixed Social Media Blur square crop error.
  • Cleaner console on boot up.
  • Added delete settings button.
  • Added Youtube playlist distinction.
  • Wavier Wave , oh that version 1.2 wave? That's dead to me now. v1.2.2 wave is my new best friend.
  • Changed over to SCSS. Cleaner for me.
  • Localised Sweetalert and FontAwesome, which should mean faster loading times.
  • Changed Windows installer. Now it installs (and uninstalls) like a proper app.
